company_name: Joint Stock Company Kaspi.kz (Frankfurt EUR line; primary Nasdaq KSPI, 1 ADS = 1 share)

fx.note: Intrinsic values computed per share in KZT and converted to EUR at spot. Discounting at a KZT cost of equity already embeds expected tenge depreciation (interest parity), so no separate FX haircut is applied — that would charge the same risk twice.

cross_listing.note: 1 ADS (KSPI) = 1 share = 1 KKS.F line unit. KKS.F is a thin secondary line; KSPI is the price-discovery venue.

valuation_philosophy: Kaspi.kz is a deposit-funded lender (customer accounts KZT 8.1tn at 30-Jun-2026, loans KZT 7.4tn) wrapped around a payments network and a marketplace. Routed via .claude/skills/dcf-methods/SKILL.md to the bank row: deposits are operating funding, not net debt; reported OCF/FCF are working-capital artefacts (FY2024 OCF KZT 582bn vs FY2023 1,106bn on loan-book timing; FY2025 capex/FCF NULL) and are not used. The model discounts DISTRIBUTABLE EARNINGS to shareholders — attributable net income x payout — at a KZT cost of equity, with a Gordon terminal on year-5 distributions capped at 12x exit P/E. This is the dividend-discount form of the residual-income model: with ROE ~40-50% and a 30% retention ratio, retained capital funds ~12% balance-sheet growth, so growth above that would need a lower payout (bear case does this explicitly). A single consolidated flow is used rather than a formal sum-of-parts because segment net income is only disclosed annually on a non-IFRS basis and the platforms share one capital base; a sum-of-parts memo on FY2025 segment net income is carried as a cross-check (sanity_check.sotp_cross_check). NCI is charged once: flows are attributable net income (Hepsiburada 13% minority already removed), so no NCI stock is deducted. SBC is charged once: it is expensed in IFRS net income and buybacks (KZT 63.5bn since 2023) absorb option exercises, so the share count is held flat at 190.73m diluted. Currency: all flows KZT, discount rate KZT, then a single spot conversion to EUR for the quote layer.

inputs.share_count_basis: Q2-2026 weighted diluted (190,730,670); period-end outstanding 190,027,266 after 737,578 buyback and 536,912 option exercises in H1-2026. Held FLAT: SBC expensed in net income, buybacks offset exercises.
inputs.net_debt_note: Bank model: customer accounts KZT 8,132bn and debt securities KZT 605bn (30-Jun-2026) are operating funding. TotalDebt in the CSV (KZT 612bn) is bond funding for the loan book, not financing to net against equity value. No net-debt bridge.
inputs.last_fcf_note: last_fcf = FY2025 attributable NI x 66% payout = distributable earnings, the owner flow used as the base. Reported FCF is not meaningful for a deposit taker.
inputs.reported_fcf_note: FY2025 FreeCashFlow NULL in Metrics.csv; FY2024 reported 486,166 is a loan/deposit working-capital artefact.
inputs.sbc_source: IFRS 2 expense is inside reported net income (H1-2026 interim note 15); the CSV StockBasedComp column is the RESERVE balance (KZT 14.2bn at Q2-2026), not an expense. Treated as already charged; immaterial vs KZT 1.07tn NI.
inputs.interest_income_note: Not stripped: interest income IS the Fintech business.
inputs.buyback_note: KZT 63.5bn across 6th/7th programs (Oct-2023 to Feb-2026); 1.6m ADSs. Offsets option exercises; no net share shrink modelled.

dividends.note: FY2025 dividends suspended for the Hepsiburada acquisition; resumed Q4-2025 at KZT 850/quarter. FY2026 run-rate KZT 3,700 = ~65% of FY2026E EPS; ~7.5% yield at KZT 49,580.

inputs.wacc_rationale: KZT cost of equity 19% = KZT risk-free ~13% (Kazakhstan 10y; NBK base rate 16.5%, Kaspi's own deposit cost 14.5%) + beta 1.1 x EM equity premium ~5.5%. Sovereign/inflation risk sits in the KZT risk-free rate; sanctions-litigation, governance and Türkiye execution risk sit in the bear scenario and its 25% weight — not stacked into the discount rate. Same rate in all three scenarios (charge risk once).
inputs.tax_note: Statutory 20% through 2025; bank rate 25% from 2026 (H1-2026 effective 21.4% vs 18.5% H1-2025). FY2026 base growth of +1% already reflects it; no further tax step in later years.
inputs.guidance_vintage: FY2026 guidance reiterated 10-Aug-2026 (Q2 results): adj. EBITDA ~+5%, GMV ~+20%, TPV ~+15%, avg net loans ~+15%
inputs.units: millions of KZT except per-share (KZT) and EUR per-share fields
inputs.notes: MODEL: discounted distributable earnings (dividend-discount form of residual income) at KZT cost of equity, not owner-FCF DCF — Kaspi is a deposit-funded bank (SKILL.md bank row) and OCF/FCF are meaningless. FX LAYER: KZT IV / 534.26 = EUR. Frankfurt line is thin; price is the 25-Aug regular close.

historical_growth.dps_growth_note: Dividends paid FY2020-24 CAGR 38.5% (175bn -> 646bn); FY2025 nil (acquisition); FY2026 run-rate ~705bn.
historical_growth.fcf_note: Not meaningful: deposit-funded lender; OCF tracks loan/deposit flows.
historical_growth.growth_rate_source: base-case FY2027-30 attributable net income path (10/11/10/9%), not a historical CAGR
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Revenue 3yr CAGR 47% (FY2025 +60% is Hepsiburada consolidation) vs EPS 3yr CAGR 22.7% and FY2025 attributable NI +3%: revenue growth is acquisition- and interest-expense-inflated. Equity CAGR 44-45% is inflated by the FY2025 dividend suspension. None used directly; forward path anchored on FY2026 guidance and Kazakhstan underlying NI growth (+13-18% FY2025) net of Türkiye drag.

scenario_narratives.bear: Kazakhstan consumer-lending cap tightened toward ~40% APR and risk-based pricing, NBK holds rates high through 2027 so deposit costs stay >14%, cost of risk drifts up from 0.7%, Türkiye keeps absorbing capital (Hepsi Bank build) without reaching profitability, and the sanctions/class-action overhang crystallises in a settlement. Attributable NI falls 5% in FY2026 then grows ~1-4%; payout trimmed to 60% to fund capital. Terminal growth 4% nominal KZT.
scenario_narratives.base: FY2026 lands on guidance: adjusted EBITDA +5%, attributable NI ~+1% (H1 -0.6%), with the 25% bank tax rate and higher reserve requirements fully absorbed. From FY2027 Kazakhstan underlying growth (13-18% in FY2025) reasserts at ~10-11% as Türkiye losses narrow toward breakeven, rate cuts begin to ease deposit costs and Marketplace VAS/advertising lifts take rates; growth then fades to 9% by FY2030. Payout 66% in FY2026 (KZT 850/850/1,000/1,000 declared and proposed) then 70%, leaving 30% retention which at ~40% ROE funds ~12% growth. Terminal growth 6% nominal KZT (5% inflation target + ~1% real).
scenario_narratives.bull: NBK cutting cycle arrives in 2027 and Fintech margins rebuild, Kasper/Alaqan lift engagement and Marketplace take rates, Hepsiburada closes part of its engagement gap and Hepsi Bank replicates the Kazakhstan fintech playbook from 2027, so consolidated attributable NI compounds 12-16% in FY2027-30. Payout rises to 75% as Türkiye capital needs peak in 2026-27. Terminal growth 7% nominal KZT.

entry_price.methodology: Entry = (PV of scenario distributions Y1-5 + terminal value (built at CoE, the fair year-5 exit) discounted at the hurdle) / shares. The 15% hurdle is a EUR return; translated to KZT via interest parity (1.15 x 1.13 / 1.027 - 1 = 26.5%) so that a KZT-denominated flow is not measured against a EUR hurdle below the KZT risk-free rate. No net debt (bank model).

required_return_table.returns_currency: KZT nominal (subtract ~10pp for the EUR-equivalent return via interest parity)
required_return_table.implied_return_at_current_price_note: EUR 92.80 (KZT 49,580) sits above every row: solving the base path for the cost of equity that returns the price gives 15.0% KZT (terminal built at the same rate). That is the international-investor rate (USD ~11% + ~4%/yr realised KZT depreciation), 4pp below the house 19% built from the local KZT curve. The whole gap between price and house IV is that discount-rate choice, not the earnings path.

sensitivity.note: Base case; KZT cost of equity x terminal growth; values EUR/share.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: 25/50/25 rather than the house 15/50/35: bear lifted to 25% for EM/governance/sanctions-litigation tail risk, the 46%->40% consumer APR cap proposal and unproven Türkiye capital deployment; bull held at 25% because the rate-cut and Türkiye-fintech upside is real but management itself does not guide to it.
probability_weighted.band_note: House and street coincide (SBC already inside IFRS net income, no separate SBC add-back basis); band collapsed.

price_verified.note: Task brief quoted EUR 92.40; live fetch returned EUR 92.80 (25-Aug close). Live figure used. Orchestrator re-check 2026-08-26: Yahoo KKS.F 92.40 vs DCF 92.80 (0.4% diff, within 5%; no update).

implied_pe_range_on_fy2025_eps.note: FX held at today's 534; KZT weakened vs EUR over the period so historical KZT-equivalent prices were lower than this implies

price_history_context.note: Stock has traded 5.4x-9.5x FY2025 EPS since 2024; the base IV sits inside that band, the weighted IV below today's 8.8x.

sotp_cross_check.note: FY2025 segment net income (company non-IFRS, Kazakhstan only) x KZT-consistent multiples (Payments/Marketplace 9x, Fintech 6x) + Türkiye at ~50% of acquisition cost. Memo only; multiples chosen so a 19% CoE / 6% growth world is respected (fair P/E on 70% payout ~5.7x, growth platforms above). Shows the market price roughly equals SOTP at these multiples.

capital_consistency.note: Base growth (9-11%) is below sustainable growth (ROE x retention ~12%), so the payout path does not require external capital.

historical_averages_ex_outliers.pe_note: Only ~2.5 years of listed history (Nasdaq Feb-2024, Frankfurt Jan-2025); no 10-year record exists. Multiples on GAAP/IFRS EPS: Kaspi has no separate SBC add-back so adjusted = reported.

sanity_check.diagnosis: No trip: implied P/E 6.1x is inside the 5.4-9.5x band the stock has traded since 2024, implied P/B 2.6x is below the current 3.8x, and base-case upside is negative (-31%). The model is more conservative than the market because of the 19% KZT cost of equity, not because of an aggressive earnings path.
